comment: The retained trust, receiver, controller and preflight validators' answer to every case the comparison tests of trust_tests.rs build, as their comparison script recorded it. Recorded by running the comparison script trust_tests.rs embedded at revision c2ecf315, unchanged and with its interpreter flags, under the interpreter and with the reference modules named here by import name and source SHA-256; each test's selection and envelope arguments and each case are bound to the SHA-256 of their text as the test serialized it. Two recordings over one dump of the cases and one over a second dump were byte for byte the same.
